ModDescription: Lights up the battlefield tiles that hide Move-Find treasure so you never walk past a hidden item, and hides each tile once its treasure is taken, both within the battle and permanently on later visits once you have collected it and won the fight. Two optional extras, both off by default and both needing the FFT Ivalice Chronicles Mod Loader: give every standard player job the Treasure Hunter ability so anyone can pick treasures up (enemy humans of those jobs get it too), and Rare treasure only, which makes every treasure tile give its rare item instead of the common one. In-process runtime; all four behaviors toggle in the mod config.
